trash.label: Move {{title}} to Trash
trash.question: Move “{{title}}” to Trash?
trash.kept: Your marks in it, and the citations in your studies, stay with it and come back if you restore it.
trash.keptMany: Your marks in them, and the citations in your studies, stay with them and come back if you restore them.
trash.text_one: It leaves your library, the Sources pane and search. You can restore it from Trash (Settings → Sources) for {{count}} day; after that it is deleted for good.
trash.text_other: It leaves your library, the Sources pane and search. You can restore it from Trash (Settings → Sources) for {{count}} days; after that it is deleted for good.
trash.marks_one: Its {{count}} mark (a highlight, note or bookmark) is hidden while it is in Trash.
trash.marks_other: Its {{count}} marks (highlights, notes and bookmarks) are hidden while it is in Trash.
trash.textMany_one: They leave your library, the Sources pane and search. You can restore them from Trash (Settings → Sources) for {{count}} day; after that they are deleted for good.
trash.textMany_other: They leave your library, the Sources pane and search. You can restore them from Trash (Settings → Sources) for {{count}} days; after that they are deleted for good.

delete.question: Delete “{{title}}” permanently?

delete.textMany: Their text, your marks in them and Abiding Word’s copies of the files are deleted.
